Scope: 18 production eight-wave campaigns; seeds1337/2026/4242, generators0/1/2 and initialrepairfalse/true. Policyv2 permits ordinary paid/refunded commands after a demonstrated uncovered repaired-blocker stalemate. All combat values unchanged; no player profile access.

Rows.Notes: Campaign policy v2: after thirty seconds without kills, with no spawn backlog and every survivor outside all completed offensive mount ranges, erase an active repair post sustaining a damaged blocker using the ordinary refund command. RecoveryActions records each command; the repair treatment means an initial repair purchase and may include this erasure. Original Player map, eight populated waves and castle HP; no starter structures or forced construction completion. Support buys reduce the same starting budget. Fixed paid mixed battery reinvests earned ink every 60 ticks; erased repair posts are not replaced. Each phase waits ten seconds; upgrades DeepInk except wave4 RapidFire. No well activation, free healing or generator replacement. Campaign Leaks is inapplicable: enemies repeatedly attack the castle. NetResource is actual generator income minus generator purchases; RemainingInk includes all production rewards and ordinary erasure refunds. Placements and Cost retain all paid purchases; RefundedInk records refunds separately. Same seed repeats a treatment; spawn admission may change the realized mixture across treatments.
